items.title: Pack struggles in loss to No. 22/25 New Mexico
items.summary: No. 22/25 New Mexico marched 56 yards to a 7-0 lead on its opening drive and never looked back Friday night, defeating Nevada 31-3 at Mackay Stadium.

items.title: Post-Game Clarity: Nevada’s Scary Scoreless Loss to UCLA
items.summary: The Nevada football team (3-5, 2-2) spent their Halloween at Rose Bowl stadium in Pasadena, California, where they were defeated by the then No. 7 (now ranked No. 5) University of California, Los Angeles Bruins (8-0, 5-0), 27-0.  The Bruins, unsurprisingly, went into the game favored and their top-10 defense did not disappoint. items.title: Nevada hosts No. 22/25 New Mexico Friday night
items.summary: It's a battle under the Friday night lights of Mackay Stadium this week as Nevada begins November hosting No. 22/25 New Mexico.

items.title: Pack drops non-conference finale at No. 7/7 UCLA
items.summary: The Wolf Pack defense stepped up to the challenge of No. 7/7 UCLA Saturday but early turnovers from the offense allowed the Bruins to establish a foothold and slowly pull away to a 27-0 victory at The Rose Bowl.

items.title: Nevada faces No. 7/7 UCLA in non-conference clash
items.summary: Nevada Football makes its first trip to the Rose Bowl Saturday to take on No. 7/7 UCLA, the game will kick off at 1:15 p.m. and air on B1G Network with A.J. Kanell (play-by-play), Brett Hundley (analyst) and Emma Carpenter on the call.

items.title: Ky Woods named Old Trapper Mountain West Special Teams Player of the Week
items.summary: Nevada running back and kick returner Ky Woods was named Old Trapper Mountain West Special Teams Player of the Week, the conference announced Monday morning.

items.title: Wolf Pack smothers San José State for Homecoming win
items.summary: A week after an emotional loss at North Dakota State, Nevada picked itself up off the mat with a full team effort in a 28-13 Homecoming victory over San José State Saturday at Mackay Stadium.

items.title: Nevada hosts San José State in Homecoming clash
items.summary: Nevada Football returns to Mackay Stadium for the first time in a month, and the only time in October, as the Wolf Pack hosts San José State in the 2026 Homecoming Game.

items.title: Wolf Pack drops road matchup at North Dakota State
items.summary: North Dakota State's Jackson Williams returned a failed Nevada field-goal attempt 100 yards on the final play of the first half, one of a handful of wild plays that cost the Wolf Pack in its 31-17 loss to the Bison at the Fargodome.

items.title: EJ Smith named to AP Midseason All-America Second Team
items.summary: Nevada linebacker EJ Smith was named to the Associated Press Midseason All-America Second Team Thursday.

items.title: Dylan LaBarbera named to Lombardi Award Midseason Watch List
items.summary: Nevada EDGE Dylan LaBarbera was named to the Lombardi Award Midseason Watch List Wednesday.
